Set up; grab data:
```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(tidy.opts = list(width.cutoff = 80), tidy = TRUE,
                      echo = T, warning = T, message = T, 
                      fig.align = "center", fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)

div_upc <- read.csv("../results/diver/diver_UPC_percentage.csv")
div_alg <- read.csv("../results/diver/diver_algae_abundance.csv")
div_inv <- read.csv("../results/diver/diver_invert_abundance.csv")

div <- div_upc %>%
  left_join(div_alg, by = c('Date', 'season', 'site', 'transect', 'depth')) %>%
  left_join(div_inv, by = c('Date', 'season', 'site', 'transect', 'depth')) %>%
  mutate(type = 'diver')

rm(div_upc, div_alg, div_inv) 

rov_pc <- read.csv("../results/ROV/ROV_percent-cover_averaged.csv")
rov_inv <- read.csv("../results/ROV/ROV_invert_abundance.csv")

rov <-  rov_inv %>%
  left_join(rov_pc, by = c('site', 'transect')) %>%
  mutate(type = 'ROV')

rm(rov_pc, rov_inv)

# Need depth, season cols in ROV data! ***
dat <- bind_rows(div %>% select(site, transect, type, ochre_mottled_star, cancer_crab, kelp_crab),
                 rov %>% select(site, transect, type, ochre_mottled_star, cancer_crab, kelp_crab))
```

Create unique transect labels such that there are 12 transects instead of 6:
```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(transect_id = paste(transect, site))

unique(dat$transect_id)
```
Abundance visualization:
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = transect_id, y = ochre_mottled_star, col = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

ggplot(dat, aes(x = transect_id, y = cancer_crab, col = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

ggplot(dat, aes(x = transect_id, y = kelp_crab, col = type)) +
  geom_point()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Abundance models: ochre mottled star, cancer crab, kelp crab
```{r}
ochre_mod <- glmer(ochre_mottled_star ~ type + site + (1|transect_id), data = dat, 
               family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(ochre_mod)

ck_mod <- glmer(cancer_crab ~ type + site + (1|transect_id), data = dat, 
               family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(ck_mod)

kk_mod <- glmer(kelp_crab ~ type + site + (1|transect_id), data = dat, 
               family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(kk_mod)
# check nb, overdisp? ***
```
